title: the fish store
content: I’ve visited this place multiple times over the years. You start out walking along the side of a building on a street in a downtown district, and you spot an opening in the sidewalk with steps that lead to an entrance to a store in the basement of that building. You walk in, and it looks like an aquarium hobbyist’s paradise. Rows of tanks in front of you with every fish you can think of, as well as plants and anything else you would need to build an aquarium ecosystem. Walls are lined with products. The further you go into different sections of the store, the weirder the scene gets. Suddenly you start seeing tanks of prehistoric fish you never thought anybody would buy as pets. They keep getting bigger until you reach a back wall where these massive fish that could eat you alive are kept, wondering why anyone would ever buy one of these monstrosities and try to take care of them. Anyone else visit this place as well?
